about: Sentences for a person to read, recorded by record-voice.mjs, for choosing how English dictation is recognised. `say` is what to read, word for word; `expect` is the text it should become once its corrections are applied. Heavy on the sounds a speech model confuses (three and free, thirty and forty, letters said alone) and on corrections said with and without a marking word.
